解封丢失的记忆（解封丢失的记忆（第22页）玄稷最后一句话脱口而出，她也不知道自己为什么会这样说，只觉得自己这样说他就会回答。果然，龙魂被玄稷的气势震慑。“既然公主执意问，那老奴就捡能说的说。小公主的娘亲确实是在上界，只要穿过这道飞升门就可以找小公主的娘亲了。”他们龙族自有一套自己的感应方式，只要在同界面的万里之遥内，都能瞬间感应到对方的气息。“不过想要冲出这道门，小公主以现在的修为是万万不能的。老奴已经回答了小公主，老奴的时间不多了，小公主你一定要好好修炼，替老奴回上界好好看看！”龙魂说完，趁玄稷在想他回答问题的空隙，化为一片黑中泛红的龙鳞，瞬间没入她识海之中，化为龙之本源充斥在玄稷的经脉里。玄稷原本停在金丹后期的壁垒，瞬间蹭蹭蹭往上涨，直突破到了元婴后期。玄稷后背比上次大一圈的龙纹一闪而过，同时那大门的缝隙里，发出了刺芒的金光，朝着玄稷而来。玄稷原本因修为上涨一个大阶，正浑身充满力量，忽觉被群山压顶喘不过气，好像还被一道看不见的铁链捆住了似的。玄稷惊慌躲避，却怎么也躲不开。她发现捆住她的那道无形的锁链，就是飞升大门缝隙里刺芒的金光。玄稷倒要看看到底是什么东西。拼着一双眼被刺的生疼，已经开始流血了，也没有闭上眼，死死盯着。她看到了门缝外，是重重缠绕的巨大铁链。那些铁链上还刻着繁复的镇压禁制，正闪着金芒。每闪一下，她只觉得身上被群山压顶的重量就重一分。玄稷只觉被压得快喘不上气了。一口小奶牙咬的咯吱作响，牙龈都开始往外渗血。足以见得她这会儿是多用力的在撑着那口气。同时脑海中突然多了一些之前她不知道，想不明白事。赶忙收敛心神，按照刚才那龙魂的传承记忆，收敛自身气息。果然气息一收敛，她越发的像个凡人，而原本压在身上的那重量也在慢慢减轻。直至现在外表看上去完全就是一个凡人，那群山压顶的气势才撤去。身上那无形的锁链也松了。玄稷忽然就明白了。明白此界为什么叫囚笼界。那是什么囚笼界，分明就是囚龙界！而囚禁关押的那条龙，就是她自己！她何德何能，以一人之力定一界之名。被拔苗助长的三次的玄稷，虽然还是个五岁不到的奶娃娃，早已经不是原先的那个玄稷了。她脑海中闪过自己最初只是一个蛋，后来蛋中的自己有了意识苏醒。那时的她是一条尚在蛋中的金色小龙，虽然她那时不知道爹娘的样子，但知道爹娘都是极爱她的，每天都会给她喂很多天才地宝。娘亲最喜欢抱着还是蛋的她，不停的喊她“娘的小公主”。原来那不是在梦中，而是现实中发生过的事。后来经过了很长很长很长的时间，长的她都记不清有多少年，终于有一天蛋壳破了，她出生了，但是爹娘不见了，应该说是她这颗龙蛋不见了。

Chapter 42 Unlocking lost memories (page 1)
Unblocking the Lost Memories (Unblocking the Lost Memories (Page 22)) Xuan Ji blurted out the last words. She didn't know why she said this, she just felt that he would answer if she said this. Sure enough, the dragon soul was shocked by Xuan Ji's aura. "Since the princess insists on asking, the old slave will tell you what he can. The little princess's mother is indeed in the upper world. As long as you pass through this ascension gate, you can find the little princess's mother." They Dragon Clan. He has his own way of sensing. As long as he is thousands of miles away from the same interface, he can instantly sense the breath of the other party. "But if you want to rush out of this door, the little princess can't do it with your current cultivation level. The old slave has already answered the little princess. The old slave has little time. Little princess, you must practice hard and go back to the upper world for the old slave to take a good look!" After the dragon soul finished speaking, while Xuan Ji was thinking about his answer, it disappeared into darkness. The red dragon scales instantly submerged into her sea of consciousness, turning into the dragon's origin and filling her meridians. The dragon pattern that was larger than last time flashed across his back, and at the same time, a piercing golden light emitted from the gap in the door, coming towards Xuan Ji. Xuan Ji was originally full of strength due to his cultivation level rising, but he suddenly felt that he was being attacked. The mountains were overwhelming and she seemed to be tied up by an invisible iron chain. Xuan Ji panicked, but she couldn't escape. She found that the invisible chain that tied her was the piercing golden light in the gap of the Feisheng door. Xuan Ji wanted to see what it was. Her eyes were hurt and started to bleed, and she didn't close her eyes. She stared at the huge iron chain outside the door. The iron chains were engraved with complex restraints, and with each flash, she felt the weight of the mountains on her body getting heavier. Her lips creaked, and her gums began to ooze blood, which showed how hard she was holding on to her breath. At the same time, something suddenly came to her mind that she didn't know she could think of before, and she quickly calmed down. According to the inheritance memory of the dragon soul, she became more and more like a mortal, and the weight that was originally on her body was gradually reduced. Only now that she looked like a mortal, the invisible chain on her body was also loosened. She understood why this world is called the Cage World. It is clearly the Dragon Prison World! And the dragon that was imprisoned was herself! How could she be able to establish a world with her own strength? Although Xuan Ji was still a baby under five years old, she was no longer the original one. It flashed in her mind that she was just an egg at first, and then she regained consciousness. At that time, she was a little golden dragon who was still in the egg. Although she didn't know what her parents looked like at that time, But she knew that her parents loved her very much and fed her many genius treasures every day. Her mother loved to hold her as an egg and kept calling her "mother's little princess". It turned out that it was not in a dream, but something that happened in reality. After a long, long, long time, she couldn't remember how many years, finally one day the egg shell broke and she was born, but her father and mother were missing. It should be said that her dragon egg was missing.
